# LobeHub

> > LobeHub is an AI agent platform for discovering, building, and collaborating with intelligent agent teammates powered by leading LLMs.

LobeHub provides a unified platform for AI agent creation and management, featuring integrated marketplaces for agents, skills, and MCP servers. The platform supports multiple AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google, with flexible pricing options and cross-platform availability.

## Key Topics

- AI Agents
- Agent Marketplace
- Agent Collaboration
- Multi-Agent Platform
- No-Code Agent Builder
- Model Pricing
- Skills Integration
- MCP Servers
- Workflow Automation
- Agent Tools
- Claude
- GPT-4
- Subscription Plans
- Credits System
- Agent Groups

## Core Platform

- [LobeHub - Agent teammates that grow with you](https://lobehub.com): LobeHub homepage: AI agent platform for finding, building, and collaborating with agent teammates.
- [Download LobeHub](https://lobehub.com/downloads): Download LobeHub desktop and mobile apps for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android.

## Agent Marketplaces

- [Agent Market](https://lobehub.com/agent): LobeHub Agent Marketplace: discover and customize ready-to-use AI agents.
- [Agent Skills Marketplace](https://lobehub.com/skills): LobeHub Skills Marketplace for Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI coding assistants.
- [MCP Servers Marketplace](https://lobehub.com/mcp): MCP Servers Marketplace: find trustworthy Model Context Protocol servers for agents.

## Pricing & Billing

- [Pricing](https://lobehub.com/pricing): LobeHub pricing plans with subscription tiers, credits system, and AI model costs.
- [LobeHub Model Pricing](https://lobehub.com/docs/usage/subscription/model-pricing): Documentation on LobeHub Cloud AI model pricing and token calculation structure.
